description:
DECISION (user, 2026-07-11): UAT becomes a REAL gate. Today it is
advisory by documented design -- docs/operations/release-guide.md:71-73
says "long-running UAT remain[s] advisory"; release-finalize gates on
exactly RELEASE_REQUIRED_CONTEXTS := validate-base release-required-result
(Makefile:1054) and scripts/release_readiness_check.py reads only
release-canary evidence. No workflow, script, or target consumes any UAT
artifact; the APPROVE/HOLD checklist (docs/operations/uat-framework.md
:418-434) is manual and unreferenced from the release runbook. Verified
on develop @ fc31f3604.

MECHANISM (mirrors the proven release-canary pattern -- readiness check
queries canary summary artifact, fails on missing/red/stale/non-ancestor,
release-guide.md:47-57):

1. GATE SUMMARY ARTIFACT: at sweep completion the orchestrator writes
   uat_gate_summary.json (versioned schema): config name,
   source_commit_sha + source_dirty (already computed for the TSV,
   report.py SourceInfo), container engine (from
   uat-container-engine-routing), completed_at, per-phase exit codes,
   accounting counts (attempted/passed/failed/timeout/unreachable/
   startup_failed/skipped incl. pruned split), validator clean rate vs
   floor, cross-scale pairs vs floor, explorer_smoke_status,
   unreachable_is_estimated, and a single derived verdict green|red.

2. AGGREGATION + ORDERING: `make uat-gate-check` reads the three
   release-gate stage summaries, enforces the cross-stage Docker
   ordering invariant machine-readably (stage completed_at fields
   replace the manual copy-paste snippet at uat-framework.md:404-413 /
   report.py:release_gate_ordering_violations), enforces the
   mechanizable APPROVE checklist items (all stages green, sidecar not
   estimated, explorer smoke actually ran for stages that include it),
   and writes a combined release-evidence file to a TRACKED path
   (_project/release-evidence/uat-gate-summary.json) that the operator
   commits.

3. RELEASE WIRING: extend scripts/release_readiness_check.py to require
   the combined summary: verdict green, source_dirty false,
   source_commit_sha an ancestor of the release PR head, age <= 21 days
   (judgement call: releases are cut every few weeks and a full 3-stage
   sweep costs an operator-day; the canary's 48h window would force
   redundant sweeps -- document the rationale). Missing/red/stale/
   non-ancestor fails validate-base on the release PR. Reuse the
   existing RELEASE_READINESS_OVERRIDE_SHA/_REASON admin escape hatch
   (release-guide.md:75-79) so incidents have the same documented
   override as the canary.

4. TUNED FLOORS (user delegated the judgement): replace the placeholder
   cross_scale_coverage_min_pairs: 1 in all three release-gate configs
   (release-gate-01:60, -02:62, -03:53 -- "Tune to the approved pair
   count during bring-up" was never done). Derivation rule: at
   implementation time, compute eligible (platform, benchmark) pairs per
   stage via enumerate_cells_with_pruning (registry + compatibility
   truth), set floor = floor(0.8 * eligible_pairs) with absolute minimum
   8 / 4 / 2 for stages 1 / 2 / 3, and write the derivation (eligible
   count, formula, date) as a comment above the value in each config.
   0.8 absorbs legitimate environment variance (a down docker stack)
   while making mass-regression impossible to sign off.

5. DOCS: release-guide.md drops the "advisory" language for UAT,
   documents the required evidence flow (sweep x3 -> uat-gate-check ->
   commit evidence -> open release PR), and the release runbook gains
   the checklist step that was always missing.

anti_patterns.dont: auto-commit evidence from inside the sweep
anti_patterns.why: the operator reviews and commits it deliberately (evidence is a human attestation plus machine verdict, and sweeps must not write to the git tree).
the checker consumes only the versioned summary JSON; TSVs stay human evidence.

anti_patterns.dont: set the floors to eligible-pair-count exactly
anti_patterns.why: a single flaky docker stack would then block every release; 0.8 slack is the point.

deferrals.reason: Cost/credential policy for hours-long multi-platform docker sweeps in CI is its own decision; the operator-run + committed-evidence model gets enforcement now without it.
deferrals.summary: Automated scheduled release-gate sweeps in CI (cloud runners with docker stacks)

deferrals.reason: Schema field exists but no envelope data has been collected; needs several recorded sweeps first.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] duplicate: release_gate_runtime_envelopes is referenced directly in the open uat-config-schema-spec-realignment item's spec-realignment scope.
deferrals.summary: Per-platform runtime envelopes (compatibility.release_gate_runtime_envelopes) feeding the gate

preserves.behavior: Existing RELEASE_READINESS_OVERRIDE_SHA/_REASON override semantics (admin-only, documented, removed after use).
Non-release sweeps (stress, nightly throughput, ad-hoc configs) write a summary but are never consumed by release readiness -- only the committed release-evidence file is.
The soundness-paths auto-merge exception: release_readiness_check.py changes may be CODEOWNERS-gated; check before enabling auto-merge.
release-canary checks and RELEASE_REQUIRED_CONTEXTS continue working unchanged; UAT evidence is an ADDITIONAL requirement inside release_readiness_check, not a replacement.

prior_art.concept: _project/release-evidence/ is a NEW tracked directory (convention: committed release evidence, curated out of release branches like the rest of _project). No existing evidence-commit convention exists -- nearest neighbors are _project/verification-logs (ignored, wrong fit) and release-canary's workflow-artifact summary (wrong lifetime: 90-day artifact retention vs permanent evidence). Genuinely new, minimal (one JSON per release cycle).
scripts/release_readiness_check.py + .github/workflows/release-canary.yml -- the freshness+ancestry evidence pattern being mirrored; extend the script rather than adding a second checker. Extend.
tests/uat/gate_summary.py is a NEW module (the w1 dataclass + serializer); nearest neighbor is the cells_io.py codec pattern from uat-execute-path-unification. Genuinely new, single-purpose.
tests/uat/phases/report.py:SourceInfo (source_commit_sha/source_dirty TSV columns) -- provenance capture already exists; the summary reuses it. Reuse.
tests/uat/phases/report.py:release_gate_ordering_violations -- existing ordering-check logic; uat-gate-check calls it with machine-derived timestamps instead of operator-derived ones. Reuse.

verifications.description: Gate summary + gate-check + readiness unit tests
verifications.expected: pass, incl. readiness failure modes (missing/red/stale/non-ancestor/dirty) and floor derivation comments present in the three configs

verifications.description: End-to-end dry-run: a dry-run sweep produces a summary; uat-gate-check over three synthetic stage summaries produces the combined evidence file
verifications.expected: summary file exists with verdict field

work_units.notes: New tests/uat/gate_summary.py: GateSummary (version: 1) + PhaseAccounting dataclasses, derive_verdict (green|red|dry_run -- reduces to "any phase exit nonzero or aborted" since validate/report floors already fold into their own exit_code()), atomic write via report.atomic_write_text, forward-compat readers that drop unknown keys. run_sweep writes the summary LAST for every sweep (dry-run, green, red, all abort paths) via _write_gate_summary_artifact; _emit_abort_artifacts now returns its partial ReportSummary so abort accounting flows into the summary. completed_at is a sweep-end datetime.now() capture. Accounting prefers the ReportSummary; a report-less execute sweep (make uat-execute) mirrors write_report's counting on the outcome (report.py's status predicates made public as is_skipped_status/is_unreachable_status for that). Tests: verdict matrix, dry-run/green/red/abort sweep summaries, unknown-key round-trip (tests/uat/test_orchestrator.py).
work_units.summary: Define uat_gate_summary.json schema (versioned dataclass, serialized beside cells.jsonl); written for every sweep INCLUDING dry-run (verdict marks dry_run); unit tests for green/red derivation

The operator python snippet at uat-framework.md (old :456-463) is deleted, replaced by the `make uat-gate-check` flow.

"gate-check" added to MAKE_TARGET_SUBCOMMANDS and the constant-vs- constant test in test_cli_dispatch.py; `make uat-gate-check` target + .PHONY added. _project/release-evidence/README.md documents the convention (operator-committed evidence, develop-only, curated out of release branches). DEVIATION: .gitignore needed a `!_project/release-evidence/` negation (the `_project/*` ignore would have made the "TRACKED path" requirement impossible) -- .gitignore was not in scope_limit but the one-line change is the mechanism's precondition. work_units.summary: make uat-gate-check + _cli gate-check subcommand: aggregate 3 stage summaries, enforce ordering + mechanized APPROVE items, write _project/release-evidence/uat-gate-summary.json

work_units.notes: Eligible = pairs whose EVERY configured rung is enumerable via enumerate_cells_with_pruning (registry truth, 2026-07-12, develop @ acfb89922) -- raw pair counts include pairs missing a rung (e.g. clickbench/joinorder 1.0-only) that the cross-scale check can never count, so raw counts would give impossible floors. Stage 1: 153 eligible (208 raw) -> floor max(8, floor(0.8*153)) = 122. Stage 2: 64 eligible (83 raw) -> max(4, 51) = 51. Stage 3: 203 eligible (251 raw) -> max(2, 162) = 162. Derivation comments written above each value; test_config.py:: test_release_gate_cross_scale_floors_are_tuned_and_achievable pins the sound band (>= minimum, <= floor(0.8*eligible), < eligible -- the never-exact anti-pattern) without pinning exact registry counts.
work_units.summary: Tune cross_scale_coverage_min_pairs in the three release-gate configs per the derivation rule (0.8 * eligible, minimums 8/4/2, derivation comment in each config)

work_units.notes: evaluate_uat_gate_evidence mirrors evaluate_canary_runs (pure, injectable is_ancestor via the existing git merge-base helper); _load_uat_gate_evidence reads the working tree first, then `git show origin/develop:...` (release/base checkouts curate _project/ away; validate-main-pr.yml already fetches origin/develop). Runs only after a green canary and combines via _combined_result, so canary bootstrap/exit-20 semantics are untouched; the existing RELEASE_READINESS_OVERRIDE_SHA/_REASON early-return covers the UAT check automatically (test pinned). New args/envs: --uat-max-age-days (RELEASE_UAT_MAX_AGE_DAYS, default 21), --uat-evidence-path, --uat-evidence-ref.
